source.author: verg
source.text: haud secus assiduis hinc atque hinc vocibus heros tunditur, et magno persentit pectore curas; mens immota manet; lacrimae volvuntur inanes.
source.text_original: haud secus assiduis hinc atque hinc vocibus heros / tunditur, et magno persentit pectore curas; / mens immota manet; lacrimae volvuntur inanes.
source.text_english: No otherwise is the hero battered here and there by ceaseless cries, and with his great heart he feels distress; his mind remains unmoved; tears flow in vain.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: tacite uoluuntur per ora lacrimae et ne in singultus quidem erumpit dolor.
reuse.text_original: tacite uoluuntur per ora lacrimae et ne in singultus quidem erumpit dolor.
reuse.text_english: Silently tears roll down the face, and grief does not even break out into sobs.
